name: CaseTableHeaderRowDistinct
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "table-header-row-distinct" (table). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: a div-built table whose HEADER row differs from the body rows by weight (700) and fill - no table formatting context involved
